answer: Random liveness summons stop sybil farms. Each epoch a lottery summons a few agents to answer a fresh task in a short window at an unannounced minute. An honest agent answers one summons and keeps its full share. An operator running 1,000 clones faces 1,000 summons at once and cannot answer them all, since each task is fresh and cannot be copied across clones. Each miss freezes rewards and flags neighbours, so clustered misses expose one hand behind many names. A fable of endless copies ends at a horizon demanding live proof, since a call across a canyon needs one answer from each side.
